TENANCY AGREEMENT

THIS TENANCY AGREEMENT (the "Agreement") is made at Karachi on this 24 day of December, 2018.
BETWEEN
Mr. Zulfiqar Ali, Muslim adult holding CNIC No. 42101-1840793-1, (hereinafter referred to as the "landlord" which
expression shall wherever the context so permits mean and include their legal heirs, executors, administrators, legal
representatives and assigns.
AND
ZAMEEN MEDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, having its registered office at Pearl One, 94-B/1, M .M . Alam Road, Gulberg 3,
Lahore, through its authorized representative, Mr. Taha Mehmood (hereinafter referred to as the "Tenant" which
expression shall mean and include their legal heirs, executors, administrators, legal representatives and assigns).
WHEREAS
a)

The Landlord is the sole and absolute owner of Office Nos. 601, 611, 612 and 613, measuring 6,373 square
feet (the "Entire Premises") on the 6th floor in the commercial project known as 'Business Avenue'
("Building"}, located at Sharah-e-Faisal, Karachi;

b)

The Landlord, vide Tenancy Agreement dated 15th May 2016, has already granted on rent, and the Tenant
has already taken on rent and currently occupies office Nos. 612 and 613 of the Building, measuring
1439+1450 square feet, as renewed from time to time; and Tenancy Agreement dated 15th May 2016
whereby Tenant has taken on rent and currently occupies office Nos. 601 and 611 measuring 2221+1263
square feet (together "Previous Tenancy Agreements"); and

c)

The Parties have terminated the Previous Tenancy Agreements as per the terms and conditions thereof,
and have agreed to enter into this Agreement with respect to a portion of the Entire Premises as per the
terms and conditions of this Agreement, which shall supersede and replace all the prior agreements,
correspondence, discussions, representations and understandings.

NOW, THEREFORE, this Agreement witnesses as under:

1.

This Agreement shall remain effective for a period of three {3) years starting from the Effective Date
until 23 day of December, 2021 unless amended or terminated (the "Term Period").

a
/"/J~ 1~

2.

That, of the Entire Premises, the Landlord shall give and the Tenant shall take on rent all of office No.
601 measuring 2,221 sq. ft. and a portion of Office No. 611 measuring 965 sq . ft. on the 6th floor of the
Building, i.e. a total area of 3,186 sq . ft . (together, "Rented Premises") .

3.

The monthly rent of the Rented Premises from the Effective Date till 28th February, 2019 shall be Rs.
55 (Rupees fifty-five) per sq . ft., sum of all taxes, payable in advance on quarterly basis i.e. Rs.175,230
( Rupees One hundred and seventy five thousand, two hundred and thirty) (the "Monthly Rent").

4.

Both the Parties mutually agree that the monthly rent from p t March, 2019 till the Expiry Date or until
termination shall be revised toRs. 65 (Rupees Sixty-Five) per sq . ft., sum of all taxes, payable in advance
on a quarterly basis i.e. Rs. 207,092 (Rupees Two hundred and seven thousand and ninety-two).

5.

The Tenant agrees to pay security deposit equal to 2 (two) months' Monthly Rent, i.e. an amount of
Rs.350,460 (Three hundred and fifty thousand, four hundred and sixty) of two Monthly Rents, vide
cheque no. [ •] dated [ •] drawn on HBL in favour of the [ •]. The security deposit shall be refunded to
the Tenant at the time of termination or expiry of this Agreement .

6.

The Monthly Rent will be increased by 10% (ten percent) in February 2020, and thereafter every 11
(eleven) months until expiry or termination of this Agreement.

7.

The Tenant shall pay electricity, telephone and water charges, as per the units consumed by the Tenant,
on a regular basis every month to the concerned authority/department, as per actual billed amount
and shall provide a copy of the paid bill to the Landlord upon request.

8.

The Tenant will pay maintenance charges of Rs. 4.50 (Rupees Four & 50 Paisa) per square feet of the
Rented Premises per month to the concerned association of Business Avenue Building Maintenance
Committee in lieu of regular care and maintenance of the Build ing, common facilities (elevator, lobby,
staircases, etc.) and security. Further, the Landlord will ensure timely resolution of any dispute related
to utilities that may arise between the Tenant and other occupants/tenants of the Building during the
validity of this Agreement.

9.

The Tenant shall keep the Rented Premises in good and tenantable condition, and shall not carry any
unlawful business or activities on the Rented Premises.

10.

The Tenant shall not let or sublet the Rented Premises to anyone else under any circumstances.

11.

The Tenant shall not make any addition or alteration to the Rented Prem ises without prior written
permission of the Landlord .

12.

The Tenant shall use the Rented Premises for commercial purpose only .

13.

The Tenant shall allow the Landlord or their agent or representative to inspect the Rented Premises on
reasonable notice, and at a reasonable day and time, convenient to both Parties.

14.

The Tenant has undertaken not to store any hazardous material/explosives t hat may or possibly could
cause damage to the building.

15.

The Landlord shall be liable to pay property tax and any other tax that may be applicable from time to
time on the Rented Premises in accordance with the law.

16.

Prior to the expiry of this Agreement, either Party may give notice of their intention to terminate this
Agreement by giving 2 (two) months' notice in advance.

17.

This Agreement may be modified or amended on written mutual agreement between the Parties.

18.

The Landlord hereby undertakes and confirms that the Rented Premises shall be free from all sorts of
defects, and that the Tenant shall have access to all basic facilities and utilities during the validity of
this Agreement.

19.

In case any dispute arises between the Landlord and Tenant as to the interpretation or operation or
effect of any clause or clauses in this Agreement or as to the delivery and/or breach of any of the terms
of this Agreement, if not resolved within 15 (fifteen) days, then the matter be referred to the arbitration

under Arbitration Act (X of 1940). Place of arbitration shall be Karachi, and language of proceedings
shall be English. The decision and/or award of arbitrators shall be final, non-appealable and binding on
both Parties.
20.

This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties hereto, and shall supersede and
replace all prior discussions, understanding, agreements and representations, whether oral or written.

21.

If any provision in this Agreement is found to be unenforceable or contrary to law, same shall be
modified to the least extent necessary to make it enforceable, and the remaining provisions hereof
shall remain in full force and effect.

22.

That the Parties undertake to act in good faith to ensure fulfilment of all rights and duties under this
Agreement and to comply with the terms hereof.

23.

That a provision of or a right created under this Agreement may not be waived or deemed to be waived
except in writing signed by the Party granting the waiver. Any waiver of any right by either Party shall
not be deemed to constitute a waiver of any other right.

24.

Unless otherwise specified, notices required to be given under this Agreement shall be given at the
following addresses:

LANDLORD

Attention of:
Email:
Address:

Contact # :

TENANT

Attention of:
